english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something repetitively and without variety.

examples.english: They followed the same routine monotonously every day, and it was so boring that I could hardly stand it.
examples.traditional: 佢日日都一成不變咁返工放工，悶到我透唔到氣。
